details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue improve?
Choices:
A) The clarify / plan / implement pipeline workflows (`ai-clarify`, plan, implement reusable workflows) (RECOMMENDED)
B) The review and autofix pipeline (`review_autofix.yml` and its step scripts)
C) The orchestrator and poller (`orchestrate_poll.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`)
D) The documentation (README.md, `docs/how-it-works.md`, agents.md fragments)
E) Something else. Please name the file, workflow or feature.
Q2: What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure. Please link the failing run, issue or log line. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Cut cost or run volume (fewer runners or GitHub API calls, faster runs)
C) Make it more reliable (fewer stalls, retries or manual holds)
D) Make the docs or the operator experience clearer
E) A new capability. Please describe it.
Q3: How will we know the change is done?
Choices:
A) You give a concrete acceptance criterion, for example "run X no longer fails with Y" or "metric Z drops below N". (RECOMMENDED)
B) The fix is covered by a new or updated contract test that pins the behaviour
C) No specific measure; take the smallest safe change in the area chosen in Q1 and Q2
